events.name: After the Refusal
events.intro: The battle is over. The Pokémon that would not follow your order sits a little apart from the others, watching you, waiting to see what you will do.

success.text: You kneel down and tell it you are sorry: that was too much to ask. It looks at you for a long moment. Then it comes and sits beside you.
You say nothing. It says nothing. After a while it gets up and walks on with the others, and the space between you stays where it is.

events.name: After the Hand-Over
events.intro: The battle is over. The two that handed over to each other are side by side, still breathing hard, pretending not to look at each other.

choices.label: Tell them they work well together.

success.text: You tell them. They both look away at the same moment, in the same direction, and that makes it worse, and then they are both laughing.

events.name: After the Mercy
events.intro: The battle is over. The trainer who told you that you could stop is packing up, not looking at you, as if it was nothing.

success.text: You thank them. They shrug, and then they do not. "Someone said it to me, once." They tell everyone on the road that you were worth the kindness.

events.name: After the Initiative
events.intro: The battle is over. The Pokémon that ignored your order, and was right, is looking up at you with its ears back, not sure if it is in trouble.

success.text: You thank it. You were wrong, and it knew, and it trusted you to understand. It pushes its head into your hand.

choices.label: Tell it to listen next time.

success.text: You tell it to listen next time. It looks at you for a long moment, then nods, slowly, the way you would to someone who has not quite understood yet.

events.name: After the Turning Point
events.intro: The battle is over. One of your team is standing a little differently now. Something happened to it in there, and it is still deciding what.

success.text: You tell it you saw. It stands taller, and it does not stop.
